component.name: Zom's Nexus
component.summary: Mod manager for Linux and the Steam Deck

description.p: Every mod you download, kept in order. Zom's Nexus gets mods from Nexus Mods and Thunderstore, keeps them in a tidy library, and puts them into your games as profiles you can switch between, without touching the game's own files.

ul.li: Nexus Mods downloads and collections, Thunderstore mods and mod packs, Mod Organizer 2 and r2modman profiles brought across
Profiles per game, with a conflict check, LOOT plugin sorting, mod installers and each profile's own mod settings and saves
When a game won't start: it reads the mod loaders' logs, shows what changed since the game last ran fine, and finds the mod at fault
Made for the Steam Deck: controller navigation, Game Mode, and mods kept on the SD card with the game
Games from Steam, Heroic and Lutris, through Proton
Optional AI help with any service you choose; no account of its own, no tracking
